author: nickyeow

english.text: By the way, what is your address?

jyutping: aa1，hai6 laa1，ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 nei5 go3 dei6 zi2 ngo5 aa3？
text: 吖，係啦，可唔可以俾你個地址我呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Japanese eat three meals a day.
Japanese people take three meals a day.

jyutping: jat6 bun2 jan4 mui5 jat6 sik6 saam1 caan1。
text: 日本人每日食三餐。

author: nickyeow

english.text: That word describes it perfectly.

jyutping: ni1 go3 zi6 jing4 jung4 dak1 hou2 ngaam1。
text: 呢個字形容得好啱。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I bought this camera for 25,000 yen.

jyutping: ngo5 jung6 ji6 maan6 ng5 cin1 jyun4 maai5 zo2 ne1 bou6 soeng2 gei1。
text: 我用二萬五千円買咗呢部相機。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Would you mind me smoking here?

jyutping: nei5 gaai3 m4 gaai3 ji3 ngo5 hai2 dou6 sik6 jin1 aa3？
text: 你介唔介意我喺度食煙呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I spoke to him in English, but I couldn't make myself understood.

jyutping: ngo5 jung6 jing1 man2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 je5，daan6 hai6 keoi5 teng1 m4 ming4。
text: 我用英文同佢講嘢，但係佢聽唔明。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't have to study tonight. I think I'll watch television for a while.

jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan1 m4 sai2 wan1 syu1。ngo5 nam2 ngo5 wui5 tai2 zan6 din6 si6。
text: 我今晚唔使溫書。我諗我會睇陣電視。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It was a long war because neither side would give in.

jyutping: jan1 wai6 soeng1 fong1 dou1 m4 hang2 tau4 hong4，so2 ji5 coeng4 zoeng6 daa2 zo2 hou2 noi6。
text: 因為雙方都唔肯投降，所以場仗打咗好耐。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You'd better take an umbrella.

jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 daai3 maai4 baa2 ze1 heoi3。
text: 你最好帶埋把遮去。

author: nickyeow

english.text: How did your interview go?

jyutping: nei5 min6 si5 min6 sing4 dim2 aa3？
text: 你面試面成點呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: When does the restaurant close?

jyutping: gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 dim2 saan1 gaa3？
text: 間餐廳幾點閂㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I have to go to the bank now.

jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 laa3。
text: 我要去銀行嚹。

author: kaenif

english.text: I can't come up with a plan right now.

jyutping: ngo5 ji1 gaa1 nam2 m4 dou3 go3 gai3 waak6 aa3。
text: 我依家諗唔到個計劃呀。

author: kaenif

english.text: She says you're cute.

jyutping: keoi5 waa6 nei5 hou2 dak1 ji3。
text: 佢話你好得意。

author: kaenif

english.text: Tom is my older brother.

jyutping: Tom hai6 ngo5 aa3 go1。
text: Tom係我呀哥。

author: nickyeow

english.text: They're on their way.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 lei4 gan2 laa3。
text: 佢哋嚟緊喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It would be nice if you could come.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 lai4 dou3 zau6 hou2 laa3。
text: 如果你嚟到就好喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I promised that I would return soon.
I promised that I would be back soon.

jyutping: ngo5 jing1 sing4 zo2 keoi5 waa6 ngo5 hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 faan1 lai4。
text: 我應承咗佢話我好快就會返嚟。

author: nickyeow

english.text: That's incredibly rude.

jyutping: gam3 mou5 lai5 maau6 ge3？
text: 咁冇禮貌嘅？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't know when it'll happen, but I'm pretty sure that it'll happen.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 ne1 gin6 si6 gei2 si4 wui5 faat3 saang1，daan6 hai6 ngo5 dou1 gei2 hang2 ding6 keoi5 wui5 faat3 saang1。
text: 我唔知呢件事幾時會發生，但係我都幾肯定佢會發生。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Did you get the letter I sent you?

jyutping: nei5 sau1 dou2 ngo5 gei3 bei2 nei5 fung1 seon3 mei6 aa3？
text: 你收到我寄俾你封信未呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: An error occurred while saving. Please try again or contact us to report this.

jyutping: cyu5 cyun4 go2 zan6 ceot1 zo2 co3。maa4 faan4 nei5 si3 do1 ci3，waak6 ze2 lyun4 lok3 ngo5 dei6，dang2 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 gei3 luk6 zoi6 on3。
text: 儲存嗰陣出咗錯。麻煩你試多次，或者聯絡我哋，等我哋可以記錄在案。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Mennad has a weird name.

jyutping: man4 lak6 jau5 go3 gwaai3 ming4。
text: 文勒有個怪名。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: This weekend, I am going to sleep over at my friend's house.

jyutping: ni1 go3 zau1 mut6，ngo5 heoi3 pang4 jau5 uk1 kei2 gwo3 je6。
text: 呢個週末，我去朋友屋企過夜。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "Hi, y'all ready for school?" The two turned their heads to the voice of Zelda coming downstairs into the large hall. "Yep. I'm going to high school!" "I know." "I'm going to be so cool!" "Now, Link," Impa was about to barge in, but the King brushed her off quickly, "Hell no, don't start that shit with us, Impa." "I just wanted to tell Link about when I went to school," she retorted. The King laughed heartily. "Oh yes, it must have been great having Jesus as your chemistry partner!" "Well I never!" "Take her away!" yelled the King to Fari angrily.

jyutping: 「nei5 hou2，nei5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2 faan1 hok6 mei6？」loeng5 jan4 zyun2 tau4 teng1 dou3 sak1 ji5 daat6 hai2 lau4 haa6 jap6 lai4 daai6 tong4 ge3 sing1 jam1。 「hai6 aa3。ngo5 wui5 duk6 gou1 zung1！」 「ngo5 zi1。」 「ngo5 wui5 hou2 jing4 aa3！」「ji4 gaa1，lam4 hak1，」ji1 mou5 paak3 zing3 jiu3 cung1 jap6 heoi3，daan6 hai6 gwok3 wong4 hou2 faai3 zau6 gon2 zau2 zo2 keoi5，「m4 hai6，m4 hou2 tung4 ngo5 dei6 hoi1 ci2 go2 di1 je5，ji1 mou5 paak3。」「ngo5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 tung4 lam4 hak1 gong2 ngo5 gei2 si4 faan1 hok6。」keoi5 faan2 bok3。gwok3 wong4 siu3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1。「o2 hai6 aa3，jau5 je4 sou1 zou6 nei5 ge3 faa3 hok6 fo2 bun6 jat1 ding6 hou2 zing3！」「hou2 laa1，ngo5 cung4 loi4 dou1 m4 wui5！」 「daai2 keoi5 zau2！」gwok3 wong4 hou2 niu5 gam2 hoeng3 faat3 lei5 haam3 giu3。
text: 「你好，你哋準備好返學未？」兩人轉頭聽到塞爾達喺樓下入嚟大堂嘅聲音。 「係呀。我會讀高中！」 「我知。」 「我會好型呀！」「而家，林克，」伊姆帕正要衝入去，但係國王好快就趕走咗佢，「唔係，唔好同我哋開始嗰啲嘢，伊姆帕。」「我只係想同林克講我幾時返學。」佢反駁。國王笑得好開心。「哦係呀，有耶穌做你嘅化學伙伴一定好正！」「好啦，我從來都唔會！」 「帶佢走！」國王好嬲噉向法里喊叫。
